keyVerseDR: "He saith to them: Come and see." (Jn 1:39)

level1.title: Come and See
level1.story: John said, "Look! The Lamb of God!" Two disciples followed Jesus. Andrew told his brother Simon, "We found the Messiah!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Andrew bring to Jesus?
Who can you bring to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I want to stay with You. Amen.

activity.title: Find the lamb
activity.intro: John called Jesus the Lamb of God. Find the hidden animals.

level2.title: The First Disciples
level2.story: John the Baptist was standing with two of his disciples when Jesus walked by. John said, "Behold the Lamb of God." The two disciples followed Jesus, and He asked, "What seek you?" They asked where He was staying, and Jesus said, "Come and see." Andrew went to his brother Simon and said, "We have found the Messias," and Jesus named Simon "Cephas," which means Peter, or Rock.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What are you looking for in life?
Why did Jesus give Simon a new name?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I want to come and see. Amen.

activity.title: Who said it?
activity.intro: Match each person to what happened.
pairs: Said, Behold the Lamb of God
Told his brother, We found the Messiah
